cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it before you tell me you're sorry.

mechanism: A assumes final authority over what counts as an apology, directing its place, wording and order to secure a personally valid acknowledgment.
confusable: Generic desire for remorse is confusable: A must regulate the form of delivery rather than merely demand that B feel sorry.
comparison: Cake scene moves a private apology before a witness who heard a wrong accusation; vase scene edits a message to correct a parent misunderstanding.
seedUse: Read all four canonical seeds. Both Drive seeds already control apology form; assess whether that control actually expresses S01 rather than assuming every insistence is the Stance.
